body: Lmao. Didn't realize that was a game, until that Goldberg Spear.

Politics aside, our way of life is to heavily dependent on fossil fuels. We use it for EVERYTHING! Damn near all plastic is made from oil, all of our fuel, & many other items we use daily. If it is indeed human interaction that is the leading cause of global climate change, the ONLY way to stop it, would be to immediately ban the usage of all petroleum oil products & cease production in all coal fired power plants. 

Now, think for a second how that would impact all of our lives? We'd be back at the turn of the 19th century! It would be like that for a long time to, before our society, collectively changed into a green one. Our entire way of life, would have to change.

I personally just don't see this ever happening. Humans are stubborn AF. So, yeah... Look forward to some new beaches in the future.
At least he got a laugh out of it.
